fields.Name: T101 - Query Result Export Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the query-data-grid ShowExport toolbar button → OpenExportDialog → mj-export-dialog in the query-viewer context, a code path separate from the entity-grid Export-to-Excel action.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Select a no-parameter Approved query so it auto-runs and the results grid populates. In the results grid toolbar click the 'Export' button (file-export icon). Success is seeing the export dialog open with format/options controls — you do NOT need to complete the download. If the selected query genuinely returns zero rows the Export button will be disabled; in that case pick a different Approved query that returns rows. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A results grid with a toolbar (row count + Export button) renders after the query runs
Clicking Export opens an export dialog with export format/options controls
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
